description: This file is a shell script used for testing and configuring git-p4 interactions, specifically for testing git-p4 cloning, syncing, and handling of Perforce depot paths, groups, and files.

methods.name: create_restricted_group
methods.description: Defines a Perforce group named 'restricted' with limited max results and scan rows, including user 'author'.

methods.name: p4_add_file
methods.description: Adds specified files in the Perforce workspace and submits each with a description.
